titles.native: 運命戦線 リデルライト

description:
"Unmei Sensen Liddell-Light" is Chiharu Ouji's new film. Its story is about a magical girl named Mitsuri, who transforms the motorcycle she rides with the power of her own soul and competes against her rivals in races.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: An in-movie anime for the live-action movie "Haken Anime!", based on the novel of the same name by Mizuki Tsujimura.
